t: Durango Maverick XP Ventilated with InsulKul Work Boot (DDB0479)
d:
Details 
 Step into high performance work in the men’s 11” Briar Brown/Crimson Red Durango® Maverick XP™.
 This style features full-grain leather with a saddle vamp, the Durango® X-treme A.C.™ ventilated shaft, air mesh lining and an InsulKul™ vamp lining to keep your feet cool all day long. This style also includes the Durango® X-Pand System™, which allows easy access into the boot for those that may have a high arch, the Durango® ACS Footbed™ with InsulKul™, a fiberglass shank and Dual-Density EVA midsole.
 The outsole has a rolled shank area with anti-torsion rigid external shank and a slip, oil and heat resisting multi-durometer rubber outsole. The style is finished off with a storm welt, single row sole stitch, 1 ½” rocker heel and square toe.
 This boot is designed to face whatever your daily grind demands. Get a pair today!
